en.headline: 3 commits, 4 issue actions, 1 discussion reply across openchamber and personal
en.summary: On 2026-10-15, `sogeisetsu` recorded **3 own commits** across two repositories, plus **17 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the two own commits updated docs under `docs(agents)` to add commit-attribution alias notes and fixed the daily pipeline so commit attribution supports aliases, including non-GitHub account emails. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, a single `chore(release): v1.15.5` commit tagged the release. Issue activity totaled 4 actions, all in `openchamber/openchamber`: opened issue #4920 about the Context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input so `其他` is always 0%, commented on issue #4111 about deleting a multi-run leaving orphaned MCP child processes and `git worktree remove --force` failing with Permission denied, and both commented on and closed issue #4346 about `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passing after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`. The user also joined discussion #4821, "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel", in `openchamber/openchamber`. No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or state changes were recorded, and no section hit its collection cap.

zh.headline: 3 次提交、4 次 issue 操作、1 条讨论回复，覆盖 openchamber 与个人仓库
zh.summary: 2026-10-15 当天，`sogeisetsu` 在两个仓库中完成了 **3 次本人提交**，另有 **17 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交**，全部位于 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，两次本人提交分别在 `docs(agents)` 下补充了提交归属别名说明，并修复了 daily 流程，使提交归属支持别名，兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，一次 `chore(release): v1.15.5` 提交完成了版本发布。issue 活动共 4 次，全部发生在 `openchamber/openchamber`：新开了 #4920，指出 Context 面板的 breakdown bar 用最后一条消息的输入去分整个会话的估算值，导致 `其他` 恒为 0%；在 #4111 上留言，讨论删除 multi-run 后遗留的 MCP 子进程以及 `git worktree remove --force` 报 Permission denied 的问题；并在 #4346 上先留言后关闭，该 issue 涉及 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 仍然通过。此外，用户在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的讨论 #4821「[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel」中参与回复。当日无 PR、review、release、star 或状态变更记录，各分区均未触及采集上限。
